name: Stanford AIMI Summer Research Internship
org: Stanford Center for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and Imaging (AIMI)
what_you_do: Mentored, hands-on summer research in health AI, working with real-world health data on problems at the intersection of AI and medicine.
who_can_apply: High school students, per the page. The page does not state age, grade range, residency or citizenship rules.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 program. Application opens Nov 10, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027. Free online info session Tue Nov 10, 2026, 5 to 6 pm Pacific, open to students and parents.
how_to_apply: Apply when the application opens on Nov 10, 2026 (the page does not describe the form). Attend the free info session on Nov 10, 2026, or RSVP through the page. Questions: aimi-hs-programs@stanford.edu.
notes: Re-read the AIMI page on 2026-10-07. The dates are for the Summer 2027 program. The page does not state pay or cost, length, detailed eligibility or whether the program is in person, so paid_type and needs_work_permit are placeholders until confirmed. Confirm those with aimi-hs-programs@stanford.edu before applying. The Summer Health AI Bootcamp is a separate program on the same site and is not covered here.
